verdict.rationale: AMD's own docs publish 256 GiB of HBM3 per MI325X, which comfortably fits a 70B-class quantized model on a single GPU. The ROCm docs also list vLLM and SGLang inference recipes, so single-node inference is plausible. The story also asks for published memory bandwidth, and no bandwidth figure appears in the evidence. missing for 10: published memory-bandwidth spec, hands-on or independent evidence of actually running a 70B quantized model, documented quantization format support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical
